author: Topsy
description:
Buying or selling used Warhammer miniatures can be a gamble. What is a half-painted army actually worth? Is that eBay listing a bargain, or are you paying too much for someone else’s abandoned project? Miniswap.gg is a marketplace for miniatures that wants to take the guesswork out of the second-hand market with historical price data for Warhammer and other tabletop systems. Here is how.

The post Miniswap: the marketplace for miniatures with data-based price tracking appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Miniswap: the marketplace for miniatures with data-based price tracking
